title: 📉 Ethereum Weekend Watch: Locked in the Range
subTitle:
Ethereum ($ETH ) is currently consolidating in a tight band, hugging the top boundary of its established trend channel. All indicators suggest a low-volatility weekend is ahead, meaning decisive, impulsive moves are unlikely until Monday's liquidity returns.
Quiet Context: The Weekend Effect
Crypto markets, particularly Ethereum, historically avoid major channel breakthroughs over the weekend. This is compounded by currently declining trading volume and thin liquidity toward the year-end, leading to the highly predictable, range-bound action we are witnessing now. Patience is key.
Higher Timeframe Analysis
Ethereum remains capped by the upper resistance of its trend channel. Crucially, it is still trading above the channel’s center line, which sits near $2,800–$2,810.
Bearish Trigger: A clear and sustained break below this $2,800 center line would significantly increase the probability of a deeper correction.
Downside Target: Should the structure confirm a deeper move (a Wave 5 scenario), the next major support zone to watch is $2,626 – $2,258.
At this moment, while the market has not confirmed a major top, early warning signs suggest the prior corrective bounce may be complete, favoring a move lower.
🌊 The Elliott Wave Conundrum
The current price action presents two compelling, yet opposing, Elliott Wave structures:
Bearish Continuation (Scenario 1): The current price action is viewed as a corrective bounce (Wave 2) within a broader bearish move (Wave 5). This scenario suggests the recent low marked the end of a corrective Wave 4, and $ETH is now initiating a 5-wave impulse move to the downside. This view gains strong confirmation if the price drops and holds below $2,800.
Bullish Diagonal (Alternative Scenario): The low recorded on November 21st may already be a significant market bottom. This scenario posits that a diagonal pattern is beginning to form. Confirmation for this bullish setup requires a decisive break above $3,245, a level aligned with the upper resistance.
⏱ The Short-Term Range
Traders should expect Ethereum to respect the current narrow range over the weekend:
🟢 Key Weekend Support: $2,983 – $3,068 (Price has recently bounced from this area, reinforcing its strength).
🔴 Key Weekend Resistance: $3,156 – $3,245 (This upper boundary aligns with the trend channel resistance).

subTitle:

Ми бачили, як ETH зріс з низьких $2.7K до понад $4.8K раніше у 2025 році, а тепер він знову в режимі консолидації.
Щоденні рухи невеликі, що зазвичай означає, що ринок чекає на свій наступний каталізатор.
Фундаментально ситуація покращилася. Оновлення Fusaka на початку цього місяця стало великим кроком вперед у підвищенні ємності бобів, а PeerDAS має продовжувати знижувати витрати L2 і робити Ефір більш привабливим для DeFi, RWAs та серйозної активності в ланцюгу.
Використання мережі знову зростає, обсяги стейблкоїнів залишаються величезними, а розробники не зникли.
Потоки ETF все ще підтримують загалом, навіть якщо є деякий шум навколо стейкінгу та регулювання.
З технічної точки зору, утримання ETH вище області $3,000–$3,100 має велике значення. Доки ця зона тримається, зниження виглядає обмеженим.
Втрата цього рівня, і $2.9K стає дуже реалістичним. З іншого боку, зміна настроїв може відкрити шлях назад до $3.5K–$3.9K.
Якщо подивитися в загальному, ETH все ще виглядає як історія 2026 року.
Структура є, їй просто потрібен час і ліквідність, щоб зробити решту.
Новини призначені для довідки, а не для інвестиційних порад. Будь ласка, читайте уважно перед прийняттям рішення.

title: Doanh Thu Khai Thác Bitcoin Vẫn Mỏng — Tuy Nhiên Hashrate Kiên Định Không Chớp Mắt
subTitle:
Bitcoin đã đăng ký cắt giảm độ khó lần thứ ba liên tiếp, và ngay cả khi doanh thu của thợ mỏ chịu áp lực, sức mạnh tính toán của mạng vẫn giữ vững trên mức 1.1 zettahash mỗi giây (ZH/s).

Tỷ lệ băm của Bitcoin giữ vững khi độ khó trượt dốc lần thứ ba và doanh thu vẫn eo hẹp hơn bao giờ hết
Các thợ mỏ đã thành công trong việc giữ cho mạng không trượt xuống dưới ngưỡng 1 ZH/s, tương đương với 1.000 exahash mỗi giây của tổng hashrate. Tính đến cuối tuần này, sức mạnh tính toán tổng hợp đang di chuyển ổn định tại 1.125,48 EH/s. Sự gia tăng này theo sau một điều chỉnh độ khó 0,74% khiêm tốn được ghi nhận trong tuần này tại chiều cao khối 927360.
[bn_top_ad]
Thợ mỏ Bitcoin đã trải qua ba lần giảm độ khó kể từ ngày 12 tháng 11, tuy nhiên sự giảm 5,06% kết hợp vẫn chưa vượt qua được sự tăng 6,31% được ghi nhận vào ngày 29 tháng 10 tại chiều cao khối 921312. Mặc dù vậy, hashrate cho thấy ít dấu hiệu giảm bớt, sự kiên trì này đã tăng tốc độ sản xuất khối. Dữ liệu từ ngày 13 tháng 12 cho thấy khoảng thời gian trung bình giữa các khối hiện tại là 9 phút 25 giây.
Tổng hashrate của Bitcoin tính đến ngày 13 tháng 12 năm 2025, qua hashrateindex.com.
Do đó, kỳ độ khó tiếp theo được dự kiến sẽ có xu hướng tăng cao hơn, mặc dù nó vẫn còn ở một khoảng cách xa, với chỉ 18% — hoặc 369 trong số 2.016 khối — đã hoàn thành cho đến nay, để lại không gian rộng rãi cho sự điều chỉnh cuối cùng để phân kỳ khỏi dự báo hiện tại là tăng hơn 6%. Đáng chú ý, hashrate tăng và khoảng thời gian giữa các khối nhanh hơn đang diễn ra ngay cả khi doanh thu của thợ mỏ vẫn mỏng.
Hashprice, hay giá trị kỳ vọng của một petahash của hashrate, giảm 9,85% so với 30 ngày trước vào ngày 13 tháng 11 năm 2025. Tại thời điểm đó nó là $42,70 mỗi petahash mỗi giây (PH/s), và hôm nay nó là $38,49, phản ánh giá bitcoin mềm hơn và thực tế là các phí trên chuỗi giờ đây chỉ chiếm một phần nhỏ của phần thưởng khối.

Trong 24 giờ qua, dữ liệu từ Luxor’s hashrateindex cho thấy các phí trên chuỗi vẫn dưới ngưỡng 1%, chỉ chiếm 0,54% phần thưởng khối trong giai đoạn này. Dù vậy, các thợ mỏ một lần nữa thể hiện sự kiên cường của mình, nhắc nhở rằng loại áp lực này không phải là vùng đất xa lạ. Thời gian sẽ trả lời liệu điều kiện về giá có cải thiện cho các thợ mỏ hay thêm căng thẳng đang chờ đợi khi năm 2026 bắt đầu.

In 2021, I took my savings of 40,000 and went all in on a cryptocurrency called "Interstellar Chain." In the frenzy of the bull market, it increased by 50 times, and my account surged to 2 million.
 
I thought I was the chosen one, quit my job, leveraged my position, and prepared to welcome a fortune of 10 million.
 
Then, the bear market came, and the project team ran away. My account was instantly wiped out, and I even owed money to the platform.
 
From heaven to hell, it only took a week.
 
That liquidation woke me up, but I did not leave. I withdrew the remaining money from the stock market and borrowed some from friends; this time, I did not touch any altcoins.
 
I used all my money to buy Bitcoin. Then, I turned off the trading software, went to a restaurant to wash dishes, and worked on a construction site, using my hardest-earned sweat to repay my ignorant debts.
 
The two years of the bear market were the quietest years of my life. I was like a lurking sniper, unmoved by the market's winds and rains.
 
At the end of 2023, the market began to warm up. When the price of Bitcoin broke through six figures again, I opened that long-sealed account.
 
The number on the screen was ten times the total loss I had during the liquidation.
 
I was not ecstatic like last time; I calmly sold half, paid off all my debts, and provided my family with a stable home.
 
I continued to hold on to the remaining half.
 
I finally understood that the true peak is not about grabbing a firework by luck but forging a key for yourself in the abyss, and then patiently waiting for the door that belongs to you to slowly open.

屏幕上的数字，是我当初爆仓时亏损总额的十倍。
 
我没有像上次那样狂喜，只是平静地卖掉了一半，还清了所有债务，给了家人一个安稳的家。
 
剩下的一半，我继续拿着。
 
我终于明白，真正的巅峰，不是靠运气抓住一根烟花，而是在深渊里，亲手为自己锻造一把钥匙，然后耐心地，等待那扇属于你的大门，缓缓开启。

🚨Leverage ratio has fallen to a six-month low: Is the market in fear or gathering strength?

Have you felt that the recent market has been particularly dull? A key piece of data may provide the answer: Analysts point out that the overall leverage ratio of cryptocurrency exchanges has dropped to its lowest point since May of this year.

Behind this is a clear signal: A large number of traders are actively "de-leveraging", reducing borrowing, and quietly shrinking their risk exposure. This feels more like a form of "collective defense" in the face of uncertainty, rather than panic.

Why is everyone choosing to "pull back their fists"?

This widespread caution is not without reason. The market is currently in a complex macro turning point:

1. Uncertainty in policy: Although the Federal Reserve has begun to cut interest rates, there are clear divisions within its ranks, and the future pace is uncertain—will it be fast or slow? No one is quite sure.
2. Transition in logic: The market focus is shifting from "speculating on the end of tightening" to "assessing the quality of easing". During this transition period, waiting and observing often becomes the most common choice.

What does "low leverage" mean for the future?

Looking back at historical cycles, a drop in the leverage ratio to low levels is a signal worth noting:

⭐️In the short term: This means that the "speculative fuel" that drives rapid market fluctuations has diminished, and the market may continue to experience a period of volatility and calm.
⭐️In the medium to long term: This may also mean that some of the potential selling pressure in the market has been partially released, potentially making the bottom structure of the market more solid. When most people have adopted a defensive posture, once a new clear catalyst appears, the return of funds may be more stable.

Thus, the current "low leverage" environment paints a picture of the market actively entering a dormant state. It does not necessarily signal an immediate surge, but it is likely accumulating energy for the next phase. Maintaining patience and observation may be one of the best strategies at present.

Most of these screenshots are easily fake or misleading.

Common Scam Tricks:

Showing unrealistic ROI with 50x–100x leverage

Hiding liquidated trades

Cropped screenshots (no order history, no time, no funding fee)

Small margin + lucky pump shown as “skill”

The Truth:

High leverage does not mean high skill.
It usually means high risk and fast liquidation.

Real traders: ✔ Talk about risk, not only profit
✔ Show losses also
✔ Focus on consistency, not screenshots

Remember:

> Screenshots don’t pay you.
Discipline and risk management do.

Before trusting anyone:

Ask for verified track record

Check full trade history

Never send money or API access

Protect your capital.
Learn trading, don’t chase screenshots.

title: Trading for beginners
subTitle:
Most people come to crypto trading to make fast money.
Most people also lose fast money.
Why?
Because they treat trading like gambling, not like a business.
1️⃣ Trading Is About Survival First
Your first goal is not profit.
Your first goal is capital protection.
If your capital survives, profits will come.
If your capital is gone, learning stops.
Rule:
> “Live to trade another day.”
---
2️⃣ Risk Management Is the Real Strategy
Indicators don’t make you profitable.
Risk management does.
✔ Always define Stop Loss before entry
✔ Risk 1–2% per trade
✔ Never increase position size to recover losses
A small loss is a business expense, not a failure.
---
3️⃣ One Good Trade Is Better Than Ten Random Trades
Overtrading kills accounts.
Wait for:
Clear market structure
Liquidity sweep or confirmation
Volume support
If the setup is not clear, no trade is also a trade.
---
4️⃣ Emotions Are the Biggest Enemy
Fear makes you exit early.
Greed makes you hold too long.
Revenge makes you break rules.
Professional traders don’t remove emotions —
they follow rules despite emotions.
---
5️⃣ Consistency Beats Big Profits
You don’t need 100% ROI trades.
Even 2–5% daily or weekly consistency
can change your financial life over time.
Small wins + discipline = long-term success
---
6️⃣ Losses Are Teachers, Not Enemies
Every loss shows:
Weak entry
Poor timing
Bad risk control
Write it down. Improve it. Move on.
The market rewards patience, not ego.
---
Final Advice
If you are new:
Start small
Learn price action
Respect risk
If you are experienced:
Protect capital
Focus on probability
Stay disciplined

$ETH Near Whale Cost Basis A Rare Market Setup

$ETH is currently trading very close to the realized price of its largest holders wallets controlling 100,000 ETH or more. This is an exceptionally rare condition. Over the past five years ETH has only approached this whale cost basis four times in total.

Two of these occurrences took place during the 2022 bear market a period defined by extreme fear forced selling and broad market capitulation. The remaining two have appeared this year making the current setup particularly noteworthy given that it is happening outside of a full scale bear market environment.

The realized price of whales represents the average cost at which these large entities acquired their ETH. When market price trades near this level it places long term holders at a psychological equilibrium neither deeply in profit nor underwater. Historically such zones often mark high impact decision points where whales either defend their positions through accumulation or reduce exposure if conviction weakens.

Because whales control a significant portion of Ethereum’s circulating supply their behavior heavily influences market direction. Trading near their realized price increases sensitivity to news liquidity shifts and derivatives positioning.

Whether this level becomes a strong base or a point of further pressure will depend on how large holders react in the coming weeks. Monitoring whale behavior around this cost basis is critical for understanding Ethereum’s next major move on Binance Square.

Contracts are quite contradictory. They can either pull you up or directly trap you.

At first, I had a bit of luck and thought I could take a risk with some money. What happened? Liquidation became a common occurrence, and my account was repeatedly wiped clean. The reason I managed to get through was not because of good luck, but because I forged my own strategy through repeated lessons.

You have to accept a fact: liquidation is not an accident; under high leverage, it is almost predetermined. Setting a stop-loss is at best just delaying the process. Fees, spreads, and frequent trades, these seemingly insignificant losses will gradually eat away at your principal.

Worse yet, many people always want to turn things around with a single trade. But the margin for error in trading is too low; one major mistake can lead to total loss. After losing 90%, recovering your capital requires a ninefold increase, which is extremely difficult.

Later, the reason I was able to turn things around was entirely due to mastering a method. For example, observing the opening and closing of BOLL to judge trend reversals. Coupled with strict discipline, I once captured a market wave that increased thirtyfold in a month. This wasn't based on gut feeling; it was the result of systematic execution.

In the end, trading is actually a battle of logic and discipline. If you are still stuck in a cycle of liquidation, recharge, and then liquidate again, it's really time to stop and ask yourself whether you are investing or gambling.

If you can't understand the trend and always trade in the opposite direction, then don't force it. There are some pitfalls you don't need to step on yourself.

title: ETH：我不是不拉，我只是想多揉你几轮
subTitle:
散户们别急着喊牛市，$ETH 庄家说：“先让我在区间里多揉你几轮，把你情绪揉碎了再决定要不要认真。”
现在这张信号给到的核心信息很明确：庄家方向偏多，但动作是“没有准备大幅推高价格，正在波段”。翻译成人话就是——多头主导不等于马上拉升，更像是边拉边洗、边走边换手，把市场情绪和筹码在区间里反复揉碎，想追涨的人最容易被“假企稳/假突破”来回收割。

庄家更在意的是“节奏”和“位置”，而不是一根直线拉上去。常见玩法就是：先把价格顶到压制区附近制造强势感→诱多/追多进场→回落到吸筹区附近接筹、洗掉高位杠杆→再二次上探甚至上破，整个过程反复几轮，直到筹码结构干净、市场一致预期被打碎为止。所以这类盘面最关键不是预测“会不会涨”，而是盯住“在哪涨、怎么涨、涨不动了会怎么演”。
上方空头压制区间有两段：
第一段3227.41–3265.50，这是最近一层的“近压”，价格靠近这里会出现冲高回落、横盘磨人、插针洗盘的概率更大；
第二段3346.54–3386.00，这是更强的“上沿压制”，如果盘面真要走一段像样的上攻，通常要先把这段压制消化掉，否则就是冲一下就泄气，给你一个“要突破了”的错觉然后回撤。
下方资金吸筹区间有三段：
3025.50–3064.88
2999.63–3040.50
这两段几乎是重叠的，说明3000–3065这一带是当前的核心防守与换手区，价格回到这里更容易出现“跌不动→缩量→突然拉回”的结构；更下方是2782.19–2806.78，这是深一点的“兜底吸筹带”，如果市场情绪或大盘带崩，往往会回踩到这里做一次更彻底的洗盘与重新定价。

结合“多头但波段”的信号，最大概率的日内路线是区间震荡偏强：下方以3000–3065为主要支撑带，上方以3227–3265为主要压制带，价格在这两块之间反复来回，过程中穿插假突破、插针扫止损。真正的强势趋势不是看一两根阳线，而是看价格能不能在3227–3265上方“站稳并回踩不破”，并且去挑战3346–3386。如果只是一根冲上去、量能跟不上、回落又跌回3227下方，那就是典型的“冲高派发/诱多回撤”，这种最伤追涨的人。
交易思路：第一类思路：只做回踩吸筹区的顺势多。你要的不是最低点，而是“吸筹区内出现拒跌信号”。执行上可以这样理解：价格回到3025–3065（甚至3000附近）后不再顺畅下滑，开始横盘、下影线增多、快速下砸又被拉回，这种才是“吸筹像样”的表现。仓位要小，因为波段盘面会给你二次三次回踩，扛不住就会被洗出去。止损逻辑要清晰：如果有效跌破并在吸筹区下方持续走弱，那就说明这轮吸筹不成立，别硬扛。目标位先看3227–3265这段，能不能吃到上沿再说；若突破并回踩确认，再看3346–3386。
第二类思路：压制区不追多，只等确认。3227–3265附近最容易出现“看起来强，其实在出货/洗多”。正确姿势是：要么你提前在吸筹区拿到了低位筹码，那就上来分批止盈、把成本打下来；要么你没拿到低位，就别在压制区追，耐心等它突破后的回踩确认，确认站稳再跟。第三类思路：短线做空的原则。庄家方向偏多的盘，空单不是不能做，但只能做“压制区的短空/快进快出”，并且必须把风险放在第一位：在3227–3265或3346–3386出现明显冲高失败、快速回落、反抽不过的结构才考虑；止损一定要短，一旦再拉回压制区上方就立刻撤，别幻想“会不会大瀑布”。这种盘面庄家最爱在你以为要跌的时候突然拉一根把空头全爆掉。
情景A：突破失败继续震荡。表现为：多次触碰3227–3265但站不稳，随后回到3060附近甚至3000附近。策略就是高位不追、低位等吸筹区信号做多，做的是区间利润，不贪趋势。情景B：有效突破走扩展。表现为：上破3265后回踩3227不破，随后再上攻3346–3386。这个时候才是“趋势票”的玩法：回踩确认跟随，把止损放在回踩结构下方，目标看压制区的突破与延伸。注意3346–3386属于强压，第一次到位很容易剧烈波动，提前规划分批止盈，别等它“应该再涨”最后把利润吐回去。
1）仓位：信号已经提示“控制仓位，小仓”，波段盘就是用仓位换容错，别用重仓赌方向。
2）节奏：宁可错过突破，也不要在压制区追涨；宁可少赚，也不要在震荡里频繁追单。
3）止损：以“结构被破坏”为止损依据，不要用情绪止损；吸筹区跌破并持续走弱就是撤退信号。
4）预期管理：既然庄家不准备大幅推高，那就别拿“趋势单”的心态做“震荡盘”，你会非常痛苦。今天的盘面更适合“等位置、等确认、吃一段就走”。
ETH当前是“多头主导的波段盘”，核心战场在3000–3065的吸筹带与3227–3265的近压带之间；不在压制区追涨，回踩吸筹区等信号上车；若能站稳3265并回踩不破，才有资格去挑战3346–3386，否则大概率继续震荡洗盘。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。

Those trying to chase the price up are most easily harvested by 'false stabilization/false breakthroughs.'

title: Prysm Bug Costs Ethereum Validators Over $1 Million Following Fusaka Upgrade
subTitle:
Ethereum’s Prysm consensus client revealed that validators lost 382 ETH—worth over $1 million—due to a software bug that disrupted the network shortly after the Fusaka upgrade.

The issue, detailed in a post-mortem titled “Fusaka Mainnet Prysm Incident,” was caused by a resource exhaustion event affecting nearly all Prysm nodes, resulting in missed blocks and attestations.

What Triggered the Prysm Outage?

Offchain Labs, the team behind Prysm, reported that the problem began on December 4 when a previously introduced bug delayed validator requests. These delays caused blocks and attestations to be missed across the Ethereum network.

“Prysm beacon nodes received attestations from nodes that were potentially out of sync with the network. These attestations referenced a block root from the previous epoch,” the team explained.

The outage caused 41 missed epochs and 248 blocks lost out of 1,344 available slots, translating to an 18.5% missed slot rate and a drop in overall network participation to 75% during the incident.

Offchain Labs noted that the bug had been introduced and deployed to testnets roughly a month prior, only to be triggered on mainnet following the Fusaka upgrade. A temporary fix mitigated immediate effects, and the team has since made permanent changes to attestation validation logic to prevent recurrence.

Ethereum’s Client Concentration Under the Spotlight

The outage has renewed concerns about Ethereum’s client concentration and the risks of software monocultures.

Offchain Labs warned that if Prysm controlled a larger portion of Ethereum validators, the consequences could have been far more severe. “A client holding more than one-third of the network could cause a temporary loss of finality and additional missed blocks. If a single client controlled over two-thirds, it could finalize an invalid chain,” the firm stated.

Despite these risks, Ethereum’s client diversity helped contain the issue. According to Miga Labs, Lighthouse remains the largest Ethereum consensus client with 51.39% of validators. Prysm holds 19.06%, followed by Teku at 13.71% and Nimbus at 9.25%. Lighthouse’s dominance is roughly 15 percentage points below what some researchers consider a systemic risk threshold.

Following the incident, developers and ecosystem participants have renewed calls for validators to consider using alternative clients to minimize the risk that a single software flaw could disrupt Ethereum’s core operations.

When Conviction Meets Leverage -- And the Market Blinks First.
Three days ago, this whale decided patience wasn’t enough.

Perpetual markets don’t wait. They don’t care how big the wallet is or how confident the thesis sounds. When price moves the wrong way, the decision is made for you.

title: إيثريوم يلمّح لانطلاقة قادمة مع تحسّن الزخم فوق دعم محوري
subTitle:
يُظهر إيثريوم إشارات مبكرة على تغيّر الاتجاه، بعد أن نجح في التماسك أعلى مستوى 3100 دولار، وهو مستوى دعم محوري حافظ على توازن السعر ومنع هبوطًا أعمق. هذا الثبات، بالتزامن مع تحسّن مؤشرات الزخم، يفتح الباب أمام سيناريو صعودي تدريجي.
من الناحية الفنية، بدأ مؤشر القوة النسبية RSI في الخروج من اتجاهه الهابط، في إشارة إلى تراجع ضغط البائعين وعودة القوة الشرائية بشكل هادئ ومنظّم. عادةً ما تسبق هذه الإشارة تحوّلًا من مرحلة التصحيح إلى مرحلة الدفع السعري.
بنية سعرية متماسكة وزخم يتراكم بهدوء
حركة السعر الأخيرة تعكس حالة ضغط سعري أعلى منطقة 3100 دولار، مع تكوّن قمم وقيعان صاعدة، ما يعزز وجود طلب متزايد عند هذه المستويات. هذا السلوك يضع ضغطًا تدريجيًا على المقاومة القريبة من 3400 دولار، والتي تُعد البوابة الرئيسية لأي توسّع سعري قادم.
ما يميز هذه المرحلة هو غياب الاندفاع العشوائي، حيث يبدو أن السوق يبني زخمه بشكل منظم، لا مضاربي. هذا النوع من التماسك غالبًا ما يسبق حركة قوية، خصوصًا عندما يتوافق الزخم مع البنية الفنية.
تداول يومي متزن وسيولة داعمة
خلال آخر 24 ساعة، تحرك السعر ضمن نطاق ضيق نسبيًا بين 3069 و3132 دولار، في دلالة على توازن واضح بين المشترين والبائعين. عمليات التراجع قوبلت بشراء ذكي قرب 3090–3100، بينما ظهرت جني أرباح خفيفة قرب 3130 دون ضغط بيعي حاد.
أحجام التداول التي تجاوزت 10 مليارات دولار تؤكد أن الحركة مدعومة بسيولة حقيقية، وليست مجرد تذبذب ضعيف. كما أن القيمة السوقية التي تقترب من 375 مليار دولار تعزز مكانة إيثريوم كأكثر الأصول الرقمية استقرارًا بعد بيتكوين.
العرض المنضبط يعزز الثقة الهيكلية
مع وجود نحو 120.7 مليون ETH متداول، واستمرار تقليص المعروض بعد التحديثات الأخيرة عبر الحرق والتخزين، تقل المخاطر الهيكلية على المدى القصير. إضافة إلى ذلك، فإن حيازات المؤسسات التي تتجاوز 5.8 مليون ETH تضيف طبقة إضافية من الثبات للسوق.
هذا التوازن بين العرض والطلب يقلل احتمالات الهزات المفاجئة، ويدعم سيناريو الصعود المتدرج عند تأكيد الزخم.
المستويات الحاسمة في المرحلة القادمة
الحفاظ على التداول فوق 3100 دولار يبقي النظرة الإيجابية قصيرة المدى قائمة. أما اختراق 3400 دولار، فقد يفتح منطقة سعرية أقل ازدحامًا تاريخيًا، ما يسمح بتسارع الحركة دون مقاومات ثقيلة.
في المقابل، كسر مستوى 3070 دولار قد يعيد السعر لاختبار 3000 دولار، وهو مستوى نفسي مهم. حتى الآن، لا تظهر السوق أي إشارات على تصفيات عنيفة أو ضغط مفرط، ما يعكس بيئة صحية نسبيًا.

title: 没空投的日子
subTitle:
今天这种日子，其实才是这个行业的常态。没有空投，什么都没发生。很多人会觉得这是“白忙一天”，但我现在反而越来越能接受这种状态。真正能赚到钱的时间，往往并不多，大部分时候，都是在等机会、熟规则、磨执行。你做的每一件看似不起眼的小事，都是在为某一次集中爆发做准备。
所以现在我的节奏很简单：没项目就不乱动，有项目就把细节做到位。规则看清楚，路径走完整，复盘写下来。至于有没有立刻的收益，反而没以前那么重要了。
回头看，我一直觉得一个相对正常、也更理性的逻辑应该是这样：先真正了解这个行业，然后选择相信；再给自己一个清晰的预期，包括时间和资金；剩下的事情，其实只有坚持。坚持跟项目，坚持学习，坚持复盘，也坚持更新自己的状态。只要你身处的是一个机会密集的行业，哪怕你不是最聪明的那一批人，只要能坚持一年，结果基本不会太差。
问题在于，坚持真的很难。坚持几天、几周，甚至几个月，其实都不算难。真正难的是，对同一件事，半年、一年，甚至更久。
就像写作，我有时也在问自己该如何坚持？说实话，我并没有什么特别的方法，只是很清楚自己在做什么。身边有不少我认可的人在日更，我希望有一天也能成为他们那样的人。我给自己设过明确的目标，从 100天，到后来更长的周期，阶段会变，但方向从来没变。更重要的是，我很清楚日更带来的正反馈并不是立刻出现的，它可能是信任，是社交名片，是认知的积累。还有一点，我对自己要求得很死，不允许破戒。因为一旦你给了自己一次中断的理由，后面就会有无数次放弃。
后来我发现，这套逻辑几乎可以套用在任何副业、任何长期事情上。你要先想清楚未来想成为什么样的人，再给自己定阶段目标和冲刺目标，然后不折不扣地执行。很多人不是输在能力上，而是还没等时间真正站到自己这边，就已经先离场了。
今天没有空投，但这并不妨碍我把一天过完。能在这种什么都没发生的日子里，依然选择记录、复盘、继续向前的人，本身就已经赢过了很多人。

translatedData.title: Days Without Airdrops
translatedData.subTitle:
Days like today are actually the norm in this industry. Without airdrops, nothing happens. Many people might feel it's a 'wasted day', but I am increasingly able to accept this state. The time when you can really make money is often not much; most of the time, you are waiting for opportunities, getting familiar with the rules, and refining execution. Every seemingly insignificant little thing you do is preparing for a concentrated burst at some point.
So now my rhythm is very simple: if there are no projects, I won't move around; if there are projects, I will pay attention to the details. Understand the rules clearly, follow the path completely, and write down the review. As for whether there are immediate gains, it seems less important than before.

title: Bug Ethereum après Fusaka : que s’est-il passé et faut-il s’inquiéter pour l’ETH ?
subTitle:
Un bug sur Ethereum après la mise à jour Fusaka a temporairement réduit la participation des validateurs. Décryptage de l’incident et de ses implications pour les investisseurs ETH.

❓ Que s’est-il passé exactement sur le réseau Ethereum ?
Après la mise à jour Fusaka, un bug logiciel est apparu sur Prysm, l’un des principaux logiciels utilisés par les validateurs Ethereum. Résultat : une partie des validateurs utilisant Prysm n’a plus participé correctement à la validation des blocs.
👉 Le réseau a continué de fonctionner, mais avec moins de validateurs actifs pendant un laps de temps.

❓ Qui sont les validateurs et pourquoi sont-ils importants ?

Les validateurs sont les acteurs qui :
sécurisent le réseau Ethereumconfirment les transactionsgarantissent que les blocs sont définitifs (finalité)
📌 Sans eux, Ethereum ne peut pas fonctionner normalement.

❓ Quelle a été la gravité du bug ?
La participation des validateurs est brièvement tombée autour de 75 %Le seuil critique de perte de finalité est à 66 %

👉 Ethereum est donc passé très près d’un scénario critique, sans toutefois le franchir.
✅ Aucune perte de fonds
✅ Aucune interruption totale du réseau

❓ Y a-t-il eu un impact pour les utilisateurs ou investisseurs ?
Pour les utilisateurs :
Transactions légèrement plus lentesAucun blocage généraliséAucun retrait gelé sur Ethereum L1
Pour les investisseurs :
Stress temporaire sur le marchéVolatilité accrue à court termePas de remise en cause des fondamentaux d’Ethereum

👉 Le prix peut réagir à la peur, mais la valeur structurelle du réseau n’a pas été affectée.

❓ Faut-il s’inquiéter pour l’avenir d’Ethereum ?

👉 Non, au contraire pour le long terme

Ce bug montre que :
Ethereum est capable d’absorber un choc techniquela gouvernance et la réactivité fonctionnentla résilience du réseau est réelle

📈 Pour beaucoup d’investisseurs institutionnels, c’est même un signal de robustesse, pas de faiblesse.

🧠 Conclusion rapide
Le bug survenu après Fusaka a temporairement affecté la participation des validateurs, sans remettre en cause la sécurité ni l’avenir d’Ethereum. Pour les investisseurs, il s’agit davantage d’un stress test réussi que d’un signal d’alerte majeur.

content:
Crypto Regulation Is Sending Mixed Signals But the Direction Is Clear

This week offered a perfect snapshot of where crypto regulation is heading.

On one hand, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission issued a blunt reminder to everyday crypto holders: custody still matters. Lose your private keys, trust the wrong platform, or misunderstand wallet security — and your assets can disappear. The message wasn’t dramatic, just practical. As adoption grows, basic mistakes are becoming more costly.

But at the very same time, other regulators are doing the opposite — quietly building the rails for crypto’s next phase.

The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency approved national trust bank charters for several major digital-asset firms, including Circle, Ripple, Paxos,, and Fidelity Digital Assets. This allows them to offer federally supervised custody and trust services — something institutions have been waiting on for years.

At the same time, tokenization is moving out of theory and into testing. The Commodity Futures Trading Commission has launched pilots using tokenized BTC, ETH, and USDC as collateral in derivatives markets. The SEC has also given a green light to the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation to begin a multi-year pilot for tokenizing U.S. equities, with real-world deployment expected in 2026.

It may look like contradiction, but it’s not.

The SEC’s warnings are about protecting retail investors from the kinds of failures we’ve already lived through. The charters and pilots are about preparing the system for what comes next — regulated custody, tokenized markets, and institutional participation.

Crypto isn’t being shut down. It’s being absorbed.

The message is simple: the bar is rising. Custody standards matter more. Compliance matters more. Infrastructure matters more.

For users, it means being more careful.
For institutions, it means the doors are finally opening.

And for the market, it means crypto is growing up.

title: 惊！BTC持有格局大揭秘，未来还能买到多少？
subTitle:
实际上，手里有“非零余额”BTC的企业数量达到了153家。这里面，上期内容里重点提过的29家上市公司是主力军，它们总共持有108.2万枚BTC（其中Other机构持有54331枚）

从图1能发现，10月6日的时候，持有“非零余额”BTC的企业才67家。后来BTC价格深度回调，这数量就跟坐火箭似的猛增，到昨天已经飙到153家了。

除了实体企业囤的BTC，现货ETF手里也有不少，目前持有131.1万枚。这里面排前三的分别是贝莱德，持有77.7万枚；富达，持有20.2万枚；灰度，持有16.7万枚（图2）。

全球各国政府也没闲着，一共持有61.5万枚BTC（图3）。美国政府以32.5万枚的持有量稳坐第一把交椅。有意思的是，中国政府居然持有19万枚，仅次于美国。不过中国政府可从没以官方形式说过自己持有BTC，真不知道Glassnode这数据是咋统计出来的。

另外，链上有些BTC都10年没动过了，数量有340.9万枚（图4）。这里面除了老牌交易所的冷钱包、真正的比特币信仰者，估计有不少是“私钥丢了或者人没了”的情况，中本聪那100多万枚大概率也在这堆里。

简单算笔账，上市公司持有108.2万枚，现货ETF持有131.1万枚，中本聪有100多万枚，丢失的币预计有200万枚。所有长期持有者加起来，总共拥有1435万枚。

 这么一看，未来市场上可供我们购买的BTC还有多少呢？真得好好琢磨琢磨。

title: Crypto Market Update: MemeCore and Merlin Chain Lead December 2025 Gainers
subTitle:
The cryptocurrency market is showing renewed strength in mid-December 2025, with meme tokens and Layer-2 blockchain solutions emerging as the top performers. While Bitcoin continues to trade near the $90,000 mark and Ethereum shows steady recovery signs, several altcoins are attracting strong investor attention due to innovation and real-world utility.
MemeCore Signals a New Phase for Meme Tokens
MemeCore has emerged as one of the standout performers in the meme coin sector this December. Unlike traditional meme tokens that rely purely on social media hype, MemeCore recently launched an EVM-compatible mainnet, giving it a functional blockchain foundation.
This technical advancement positions MemeCore at the intersection of meme culture and utility-driven blockchain design. The project has also attracted interest from institutional investors, indicating a shift in how meme-based assets are evaluated in the current market cycle. Meme tokens are increasingly evolving to include staking, cross-chain features, and reward mechanisms rather than remaining purely speculative.
Layer-2 Networks Maintain Strong Momentum

Layer-2 blockchain projects continue to demonstrate sustainability and long-term relevance. Merlin Chain, a Bitcoin-native Layer-2 solution, is gaining traction by using zero-knowledge rollup technology to improve transaction speed and efficiency on the Bitcoin network.
Other Layer-2 platforms are also drawing attention for addressing core blockchain challenges such as scalability, transaction costs, and enterprise adoption. These developments suggest that Layer-2 infrastructure is becoming a critical component of blockchain growth rather than a temporary trend.
TRON Remains the Stablecoin Powerhouse
TRON continues to dominate stablecoin transactions, particularly for USDT transfers. While its price movement has remained relatively modest, the network processes a massive volume of daily transactions, especially in emerging markets where low fees are essential.
This consistent usage highlights TRON’s strength as a utility-focused blockchain with real-world payment relevance, separating it from projects driven primarily by short-term price speculation.
Market Outlook for Late 2025
As the year draws to a close, investor focus is shifting toward fundamentally strong projects with proven use cases. Large-cap assets such as Bitcoin and Ethereum provide market stability, while Layer-2 networks and next-generation meme projects are offering growth opportunities.
The broader crypto market is signaling a transition toward maturity, where technology, adoption, and institutional participation play a greater role in determining long-term value.
Conclusion
The top crypto gainers of December 2025 reflect a clear trend: projects combining innovation, scalability, and practical utility are outperforming hype-driven assets. MemeCore’s evolution beyond traditional meme tokens, Merlin Chain’s Layer-2 advancements, and TRON’s stablecoin dominance collectively highlight the direction in which the crypto market is heading.

title: The Most Important Trading Rule Beginners Ignore: Risk Comes Before Profit
subTitle:
Most beginners enter trading with one question in mind:
“How much can I make?”

Professionals ask a different question:
“How much can I lose if I am wrong?”

This single difference separates long-term survivors from short-term gamblers.

---

1️⃣ Why Beginners Ignore Risk (And Pay the Price)

Beginners focus on:

Entry price

Indicators

Targets

Leverage

They ignore:

Position size

Stop-loss discipline

Account protection

The result?

One bad trade wipes out five good ones

Confidence collapses

Emotions take control

📌 You don’t blow accounts because of bad analysis — you blow them because of bad risk control.

---

2️⃣ The Hidden Truth: Accuracy Does NOT Matter

You can be right 40% of the time and still make money.

How?

Small losses

Bigger wins

Controlled risk

Example:

Risk ₹1 to make ₹2

Win 4 trades, lose 6

Result = profit

But if you:

Risk ₹5 to make ₹1

Even 70% accuracy will destroy your account

📌 Risk–Reward > Win Rate

---

3️⃣ The Leverage Trap (Beginner’s Favourite Mistake)

Beginners think:

> “Higher leverage = higher profit”

Reality:

Higher leverage = faster liquidation

Emotions spike

Stops are ignored

Losses become uncontrollable

Professionals:

Use low leverage

Increase size only after consistency

Protect capital like a business asset

📌 Leverage is a tool, not a shortcut.

---

4️⃣ The One Rule That Saves Accounts

> Never risk more than 1% of your capital on a single trade.

Why?

10 losses = still alive

20 losses = still trading

Your mind stays calm

Discipline stays intact

Trading is a probability game, not a prediction contest.

---

5️⃣ Why “Waiting” Is a Skill (Not Laziness)

Beginners feel the need to:

Be in every move

Trade every candle

Recover losses quickly

Professionals:

Wait for price to come to their level

Skip bad conditions

Trade less, earn more

📌 No trade is often the best trade.

---

6️⃣ Final Truth (Read This Twice)

You don’t need:

Perfect indicators

Secret strategies

Paid signals

You need:

Risk control

Patience

Discipline

Consistency

> The market will always be there.
Your capital won’t — if you don’t respect it.

---

🧠 Remember:

Your first job as a trader is not to make money.
Your first job is to stay in the game.

The currency $FIS  is the native currency of the StaFi protocol, which is a project in the decentralized finance (DeFi) sector aimed at solving the liquidity problem for staked assets. 
Here are the key details about the StaFi (FIS) project in 5 lines:
Project: StaFi is a protocol that allows users to stake their cryptocurrency based on the proof of stake (PoS) mechanism and receive immediate liquidity in return.
Function: When a user stakes their assets (such as $ETH  or $DOT ) through StaFi, they receive "staked derived tokens" (rTokens) that represent the staked assets and their staking rewards.
Value: These tokens (rTokens) allow users to utilize their staked assets in other financial activities (such as lending or providing liquidity on decentralized trading platforms) without needing to unstake and lose rewards.
Strength: The project is strong in concept as it addresses a real and significant issue in the world of decentralized finance, which is reconciling liquidity with earning staking rewards.

title: $AT (APRO): Bringing Clarity and Care to On-Chain Finance
subTitle:
$AT When I first explored APRO , I did not think of it as another crypto project following hype or quick wins. It was a nice pause in a world that is more often filled with buzz and speculation. APRO is quietly constructing something more fundamental and difficult than one-dimensional: a system in which people get a true understanding of where their cash goes, how strategies work and why every decision is critical. It is about making financial principles accessible to everyone, and to the entire world of business as everyone can see it, follow, and trust it.
At its most basic level, APRO is an asset management protocol in which well-established, stable financial strategies are converted into tokenized, on-chain products. These types of On Chain Traded Funds, OTFs, are not simply symbolic tokens. They all indicate a finely grained plan—all the way from quantitative investing and volatility control to structured yield products. Where observers must sit around waiting, reading reports, or trusting an obfuscating institution, they are shown how their capital is fluctuating throughout time. This means every rule, every allocation, and every adjustment is transparent. Trust is no longer an abstract — it is real.
APRO has a simple architecture that is elegant. Simple vaults manage single strategies without obscuring performance and risk. Composed vaults are a group of several simple vaults that is mixed together in more diversified products with better level of equity and less confusion. This system replicates portfolio creation in the real-world, but provides transparency in a way that is not common outside the industry. Users don’t have to figure out any of the obscure layers of complexity — they can have as clear a reading of the flow of capital as they can do of a ledger.
APRO’s AT token forms a hub of this ecosystem, acting as a governance mechanism and embodiment of alignment. Token users are able to participate in decision-making, guiding incentives, strategies, and future paths. The platform incentivizes commitment by means of mechanisms that reward patience that also promote the long-term thinking that characterizes participation. The gatekeepers to AT tokens accumulate power, supporting a culture of responsibility, foresight, and alignment — all at the expense of short-term reward.
At APRO, risk is handled fairly throughout. We openly acknowledge market uncertainty, strategic underperformance and smart contract vulnerabilities. Transparency is not risk-free, it is empowering, for participants to see it and to find their way through. And so APRO makes fear less terrifying and more approachable, encouraging decision-making based on transparency instead of gut sense.

title: The​‍​‌‍​‍‌​‍​‌‍​‍‌ Unwritten History: What YGG Learned When the Yield Ran Out IV
subTitle:
For a long time, the most common measure of a DAO's success was simply how much money it had in the Treasury. I was taught in the early days of Web3 that true decentralization means having a lot of money. Over time, I learned that true decentralization comes from having a decision-making structure that is distributed, resilient, and ethically solid. I learned that the design in the core of a DAO is what will primarily drive that DAO's future financial success.
YGG’s structural evolution, in fact, culminated in the final and most important shift of moving beyond being simply a financial entity to becoming a governance framework that social- contractually formalizes and uplifts its community to a global scale.
The Challenge With Centralized Governance
Just like other DAOs, YGG initially faced a major issue. It was the centralization risk with regards to governance. The handling, access, and decision-making on the use of multi-million dollar resources were, most of the time, only a few of the founders or large holders of the tokens. This caused the paradox to exist, where the few with most of the decision-making power, while the majority, the players generating, had none. Instability of this type, while proportional to early governance in Web3, was in danger of proving the guild's mission to democratize governance trivial.
YGG turned to creating a plan in the form of a hierarchy, to decentralize intelligence and the governance of the DAO to the edges, so as to best reflect the DAO's community on a global scale.
The Implications of Policy Enforcement: The Sovereignty of SubDAOs
The Modular SubDAO Model is both a financial firewall (explained in Part 2) and a Policy Enforcement Primitive. It places the main YGG DAO in a position to delegate governance to the local, granular levels of specialists, reducing the risk of a single, uniform policy failure as a result of mismatch.
Localized Governance: SubDAOs are allowed to govern YGG and have their own native tokens and geographically restricted voting powers. A decision on an NFT acquisition strategy at an IndiGG SubDAO (India-focused) need not have a token holder from London vote, as those that understand the local market and regulatory architecture best can decide without external interference.
The Shared Constitution: The core YGG DAO retains powers in the system only in matters that pertain to the overarching constitutional principles, which are: the protection of the treasury, updates of the protocol code, and the regulatory parameters set for the Guild Advancement Program (GAP). Everything else, including the allocations from the specific P2E split and payments to community managers, is not controlled by YGG DAO. In this way, the basic constructs of the system are preserved, and the local system is allowed to operate without unnecessary rigidity.
Policy Relations Power: Impact Resulted from Policy Distribution rather than Policy Centralization.
The Financialization of Social Capital
The GAP program is the most decentralized in terms of governance. As already explained, the main purpose of GAP is to financialize social capital, while it also records the in-game performance and contributions of players to the ecosystem.
Voting Weight by Contribution - On-chain player reputations are displayed through the nontransferable SBTs that are issued through GAPs representing the player’s digital identity. While the core token governs the treasury, SBTs can be viewed as a weighting factor in the governance votes pertaining to player policies, asset redistribution, and the establishment of new SubDAOs. This approach incorporates a proof-of-contribution dimension into governance to ensure that governance in not solely financial in nature, but instead, there are actionable, non-transferable contributions.
The Moral Hedge - This structural balance is YGG’s moral hedge. It is protecting against a large token whale’s predatory policy that tries to exploit the active player base by forcing a predatory policy. The governance weight is distributed over thousands of smaller, verified contributors. Players, in this case, are incentivized to be active and engaged since their reputation can be converted into real political power in the ecosystem.
The Key takeaway from this is Sovereignty is Derived from Structure.
The silent triumph for YGG is the realization that the most robust form of decentralization is the one that primarily relies on structural, economic, and incentivization mechanisms to align the interests of the few: the investors, with the many: the players.
By creating a structure where:
Risk exists within a subregion (SubDAOs).
Reputation can be politicized but is also recognized (GAP).
Core policy is stripped down so it can be nimble.
YGG achieved a rather impressive feat: a high level of governance stability within the extremity of the governance model in Web3 gaming. This unwavering allegiance to stably held, decentralized authority is the main thing that ensures YGG will outlast all competitors. In the process, YGG has preserved the social contract of the DAO despite market conditions and will continue to do so. The structure is the ​‍​‌‍​‍‌​‍​‌‍​‍​vow.
